approved_scope.title: Reuse one cat-file batch reader per repository root across nested repository-fact scopes
approved_scope.description: Reuse one cat-file batch reader per repository root across nested repository-fact scopes
acceptance_criteria: A batched read inside a scope nested in an open same-root scope reuses the outer scope's cat-file --batch reader instead of starting a second one (REQ-git-utils-010)
A failing unit test shows two batch children for one root before the fix and one after
Invalidation still closes every frame's reader, so a read after a git write sees the new state
Per-command spawn ceilings in lifecycle_commands_stay_within_git_spawn_ceilings still pass and no count rises

answers.constraints: SPEED-1.c and REQ-git-utils-010: one cat-file --batch child per root per command, and invalidation must still discard every reader so no stale ref snapshot is reused
